These crosses can distinguish author loyalty and content-format preference from rapid repeat-content fatigue, and avoid treating static user attributes as standalone ranking signals. The content fields provide item-varying context for duration- and satisfaction-related preferences rather than merely adding constant user effects.
iterations.rationale: The rejected LambdaRank result shows that tree listwise ranking did not exploit the available signals effectively, while DIN listwise sequence attention also failed to improve, so a bold change to pairwise neural ranking is warranted under the convergence warning. Unlike simply increasing embeddings or adding static side features (both known dead ends), `--cwm` supplies candidate-varying content fields whose interactions can capture whether a user genuinely long-views a music/type/upload style rather than impulsively clicking clickbait.
